ability.infinity.power_stone.sky_fist.de: Left (aim, up to 48 blocks): a purple layered magic circle opens in the sky above the point, the sky darkens there and a giant runed forearm comes down with its fist closing, slamming the spot: shockwave ring, dust, flying rocks and camera shake. Weak damage (about 6 hearts, 3-4 block radius) and knockback. The ground is dented by a crater that restores itself in about 10 s. Right: open-palm slam, knockback only, no damage. Scroll: fist size 1-3.
infinity.wheel.dual.sky_fist: Left: fist from the sky  ·  Right: palm slam (knockback only)
ability.infinity.power_stone.sculptor_ha: Left (aim): two giant hands of stone and purple light rise from the ground and mould the terrain like clay, raising a smooth, permanent hill or mountain in the local ground type, layer by layer. Right: they dig a valley (pick lake in the middle-click menu to fill it with water; below sea level water fills in by itself). Respects protected land. Scroll: radius 4-24 (the height follows).
infinity.wheel.dual.sculptor_hands: Left: raise terrain  ·  Right: dig valley or lake
ability.infinity.power_stone.gauntlet_wi: Complete gauntlet. Left: grants the selected wish. Right: menu of harmless, temporary wishes: flower rain, a feast on a floating table, a rainbow across the sky, a fireworks show or a starry night with shooting stars (everyone nearby sees it). Scroll: change wish.
infinity.wheel.dual.gauntlet_wish: Left: grant the wish  ·  Right: wish menu
ability.infinity.power_stone.creator_han: Complete gauntlet. Left (aim): a colossal golden gauntlet with the six stones descends from the clouds, opens its fingers (the stones light one by one) and closes its fist over every living being in the radius, players included, lifting them all into the sky inside the hand with no way out. Right: squeeze (strong damage pulses; protected land blocks the damage to players); right again: open the hand and set everyone down gently. Scroll: radius 4-16. Everyone is released if you leave the game, die or drop the gauntlet.
infinity.v2a.sculptor.valley.desc: Digs a valley. Fills with water only below sea level.
infinity.v2a.sculptor.lake.desc: Digs a basin and fills it with water.
infinity.v2a.wish.flowers.desc: Flowers fall from the sky around you.
infinity.v2a.wish.feast.desc: A laden table appears in front of you.
infinity.v2a.wish.rainbow.desc: A giant rainbow crosses the sky.
infinity.v2a.wish.fireworks.desc: A fireworks show in the sky, no damage.
infinity.v2a.wish.stars.desc: The sky fills with stars and shooting stars.
infinity.v2a.creator.busy: The hand is already open over someone
